g.text: Climate graphs A, B and C (same scales; invented data)
total 2,000 mm; every month wet; range 1 °C
total 500 mm; wettest Dec–Mar, dry Jun–Aug; range 9 °C
A: high rainfall in every month (2,000 mm a year) and a very
small temperature range (1 °C): consistent with rainforest.
B: a marked wet season (wettest December to March) and dry months
(June to August), 500 mm a year, with a larger range (9 °C):
C: very little rain (20 mm a year) and the largest range of the
three (13 °C): consistent with an inland tropical desert.
